steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Sir, all ceremony attendees are under our control now, and Reynell has been secured on his balcony.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Good. Are our reinforcements in position?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Fifteen trucks are parked outside the gallery perimeter.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You don't need me to tell you what to do next.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Sir!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Remember, tell those huasos not to wreck the art as they load it on the trucks.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: If anyone damages a single piece, I'll take a finger off them.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Oh, also, don't forget to confiscate the terminals off those pampered shits.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: And any belongings they have on them, I'm assuming we also...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Hmph. You get it, I like that.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I don't care how you handle the people, but the art, you use a feather touch on that.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Go. I still need to see Señor Reynell about something.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Good morning. Nice view of the sunrise?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Sorry, you're far too cultured for that. I should be asking you if it's 'beautiful,' no?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The silent treatment? If you think you're any safer for it, you're gravely mistaken.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: But let's get on topic, which is that I have no topic for you. All you need to do is sit here, behave, and act like you're a victim of a terror attack.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: —That's what you're casting me as?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Oh, look at that. You do have a mouth.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Sorry, my fault. I thought you'd seen through something or other, but then I thought a little more, and no, this is just the coincidental idiotic concoction of a man blinded by greed.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: How about that? Upstanding airs a moment ago, and now you're starting to lose your temper.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No, I have no complaints at all regarding this coincidence. Because I've come to see it for what it is, simply the finishing touch on my final creation—

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: And of course, because it was coincidence and not your intention, I thank Lady Luck before you, Captain.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Excellent. Now shut up.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Sir, Sir!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: What? Intruders?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: No, actually, it's...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: We'd better talk inside.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá, did we get the date wrong or what?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Impossible. Look at the scene—a crowd was here just moments ago. Something happened.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: So someone saw us, reported to Reynell, and he ran back inside the gallery?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: This isn't Reynell's MO. Supposing he did know we were coming, he might be outraged, or excited, but he'd never turn tail and run.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: So what is this...?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Huh? A terminal? Is that mine?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hello? Ernesto?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Speaking.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: How's it going? Getting somewhere with your personal business?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Arleta, notify the street art people not to go near the Galería, at least for today.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What? Why?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: They've planted a huge amount of Originium explosives in there, ready to blow at any time.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Originium what?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Eheh... ahaha...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Arleta, I don't like the sound of that laugh. Where are you?

spans.text: Arleta, I don't like the sound of that laugh. Where

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Me, Ela's gang, Tecno, Diaz, the artists... everyone's in the plaza in front of the gallery right now.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: So why don't you get out of there, fast?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Sorry, bro, but I've got a few questions for you too.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ernesto, why are you this clued in? Where are you?

spans.text: Ernesto, why are you this clued in? Where are

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Cool, got it. Tell me every last piece of information you have, Ernesto.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Arleta!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Or else I'm going in to save you like I don't know a damned thing.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Pelotudo!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I tell you to make sure your men don't wreck the artwork, and you proceed to ruin one personally!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Sir, just hear me out! Inside that pitcher I broke, there was a... a...

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: ...An Originium bomb.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: A what?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: And it's—it's not even the only one!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: I spotted a suspicious wall in the stairwell, like it was freshly plastered over, which didn't seem right...

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: So you broke the wall down? And there were bombs there too?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Not bombs, they were... detonation controller nodes... which means there's more than one detonator, and there could be more explosives than we know.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: —That's what you're casting me as?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I thought you'd seen through something or other, but then I thought a little more, and no, this is just the coincidental idiotic concoction of a man blinded by greed.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Sir, these things could level the whole gallery! And we don't even know how they detonate! It could be manual or timed!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Let's load everything as fast as we can, take the cash of the rich guys, and call it here!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: You're ready to just walk away?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: The bombs are inside the Galería! Ready or not isn't the question here, sir!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: If we don't pull this off, we'll be public enemies of the Coalition government and Dossoles!

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: All we have to do is run! They won't catch us!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Run where? Into the wilds? Hand a couple hundred gold certificates to each man and disband? What have we been risking our lives for?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: No—Sir, I'm serious, if worst comes to worst we can ditch the country as mercenaries—or bandits!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Bandits?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: I... I'm just supposing, my point is we don't have to play along with Reynell's insanity.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Fine, I get it. Who else knows of this?

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Only me—I haven't dared tell anyone else. I was worried the news would panic the men, so I came straight to you.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Very well done.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Go. Tell them they can stop hauling. Clean the cuicos downstairs of every last drop of their grease, then we evac immediately.

steps.name: Commanding Officer
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Oh, also, stop losing your head. Speak calm, walk slow, and don't let them see a single crack. You hear me?
The soldier about-faces, then breaks into a run for the stairs. Suddenly comes the sound of a bowstring.
He has no time to look back before a heavy bolt pieces straight through his back and protrudes from his chest.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: My boy, after so much loyalty, so much preparation, so many decisions, so many points of no return... you go off to be a bandit?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: I lost my chance to turn back.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: So did you.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: A terrorist attack 'collage?'

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Reynell set up the bombs, the Captain took the crowd hostage, and neither seemed to know what the other was up to. That's what Ernesto tells me, anyway.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: ...They're both insane.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Yeah, both of them are crazy. We need to prep for the worst-case scenario, with the hostages prioritized above all else on all counts.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Let's hash out a concrete plan of action. We've got five names to our side. Iana, Doc, Fuze, me, and Rhodes Island's Catapult...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Count me in too.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Don't forget my past life.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Besides, it's not just that Reynell bastard trapped in there, and not just the investors either—many are ordinary folk. I have to go.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Papá...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Don't try talking me out of it, I'm going.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Who's talking out? I'm going too!

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: You and the others can forget it. It's dangerous in there—

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Come on, Papá, think about it. Sure we've never been firefighters, but otherwise, we're thinking everything you're thinking, no?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Guys, listen to me! We're about to rescue everyone in the Galería!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: This is entirely voluntary! Everyone who's in, step forward and listen to Ela!

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: If you don't want to go, no pressure! Head back to the neighborhood, in case Mateo makes a move on our community and screws us before he's down for good!

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: What do you think? You going?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Don't wanna die, I'll be real. I'm not going. Think of all the pictures still waiting for me to take them.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: (Shrug) I kinda want to see those art investors piss their pants in fear.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: That's tasteless.

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: Tasteless?

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Pant-pissing's no good show. What I wanna see is the art Reynell bought.

spans.text: wanna see is the art Reynell bought.

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: I thought you'd have to cough up for tickets from Reynell to see the goods, but it changes things if we're going in to save them anyway—

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I—I—I mean, if you're gonna...

steps.name: Community Hawker
steps.text: What are you pulling out Reynell's pamphlet for?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: ...This.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Galería Krysztauowa Exhibition Hall 2, Exhibit 14. An anonymous Minoan bard's manuscript from the night before Sargon annexed Minos.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: How could such a beautiful poem, such a precious manuscript, end up bought by Reynell...

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I learned Minoan just for this one poem! I'll recite it for you right now—

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: Don't bother. It's all Minoan to me.

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Community Artist
steps.text: *sigh* What the heck are you crying for?

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: When I just think about that bard's bitter fate, and then I think about that manuscript, and then I think about me, I just—I just...

steps.name: Community Resident
steps.text: I'm going, is what I am! Even if the bombs blow me up when I see it, it'll be worth it! I have to go!!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Considering the number of hostages, we can have the majority of our people evac the ones we rescue. Best leave HVT suppression and explosive disposal work to us.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Catapult, is Tequila on comms right now?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I got him.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Tequila?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Miss Ela? Don't tell me you're crashing the Galería with Arleta. It's dangerous in here—

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: We're the ones you hire to deal with this sort of thing, sir.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Catapult says you're trapped in a darkroom on the east wing third floor of the gallery, and the room is filled with explosives. Seeing how lively it is downstairs, there should be plenty of people shut in there, correct?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Are the Captain's men in there? Have they noticed the bombs?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: They should be there, but it's too noisy. I can't quite make anything out... hold on—

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Tequila?!

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Whisper) Two soldiers passed by the darkroom entrance just now. They were discussing how to load the art onto their trucks.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Good. That's what we'll build our plans around.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) Say, is something this small really gonna blow up whoever's in there?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) Blowing up the galería's glass walls is one thing, but we're talking about the warehouse that Mateo used as his command node. Who knows if he has patched up the walls here...

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: (Whisper) Of course it will.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: (Whisper) But... okay, you're rappelled outside the second floor, but you're still standing against a wall... Shouldn't you bust a window, and throw these things in?

steps.name: Voices from Behind Bunker
steps.text: Did you hear something just now?

steps.name: Voices from Behind Bunker
steps.text: It was like... donk, donk, donk?

steps.name: Voices from Behind Bunker
steps.text: Well, except it was five donks.

steps.name: Voices from Behind Bunker
steps.text: Three.

steps.name: Voices from Behind Bunker
steps.text: Who gives a damn if it was three or five? Doesn't matter, we can die of old age holding this bunker if we want. All those idiots in the plaza can do is stand around drooling—

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Deployed! Time to pull back!
A string of explosions rings out of the building.
Catapult's jaw hangs slack as she stares at Fuze. About to offer a word of admiration, Fuze shakes his head at her.
And then from inside the room, an even more violent explosion. The Cluster Charge has ignited the explosives cache within.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Ela, this is Fuze. We should have hostiles from perimeter defense coming out now. Get ready to engage.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: And Catapult, it's about time we move.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Don't you think... the explosions already woulda knocked them out?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Never assume your enemy's an idiot, even if he really is.

steps.name: Distant Soldiers
steps.text: Incoming, incoming!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Are you... some kinda genius?

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Not in a million years. What I have is training, intel, synergy with my teammates, and just a little pinch of technology.

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: It's that simple.
